page: Microsoft Azure M128ms is a memory-intensive virtual machine built for extremely large in-memory workloads. Powered by the Intel Xeon 8280M processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance allocates 128 dedicated vCPUs derived from 64 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system features 3892.0 GB of system memory, providing roughly 30.41 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware features include AVX, AVX-512, and AES instruction sets, while operating without discrete GPU accelerators. Fast temporary storage is provisioned via 4398 GB of local SSD capacity under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark results reflect the architecture of a high-density, multi-socket platform. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 375.19 GB/sec, placing it in the top 10 percent of tested instances, paired with strong large-block write bandwidth of 150.99 GB/sec. Parallel compute and throughput benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core CPU testing and PassMark CPU scores, rank in the top quartile. The system achieves 79.29 million Redis SET operations per second and 56.96 GB/sec in static web serving. Conversely, single-threaded processing presents a clear architectural tradeoff: Geekbench single-core, single-threaded gzip compression, and stress-ng single-core tests show modest bottom-decile scores due to conservative per-core clock targets across the massive core count.

Given its footprint, Microsoft Azure M128ms delivers cost efficiency specifically when consolidating massive database footprints that demand colossal memory pools and dense multi-threaded parallelism rather than high per-core serial compute. It is directly matched to production enterprise environments such as large SAP HANA deployments, massive in-memory databases, large-scale Redis clusters, and extensive data warehousing analytics.
description: Microsoft Azure M128ms is a memory-optimized cloud virtual machine engineered for colossal in-memory enterprise workloads. It is powered by Intel Xeon 8280M processors utilizing the x86_64 architecture, delivering 128 dedicated vCPUs across 64 physical cores at 2.7 GHz. The system provides 3892.0 GB of RAM alongside 4398 GB of local SSD storage, omitting discrete GPUs. Benchmarks demonstrate elite large-block read memory bandwidth reaching 375.19 GB/sec alongside top-tier multi-threaded processing and high Redis throughput of 79.29 million operations per second. However, single-core execution speeds and single-threaded compression throughput place in the lower performance tiers, reflecting the distributed multi-socket design. This server offers cost-effective scalability for monolithic memory footprints, making it tailored for enterprise SAP HANA systems, memory-resident relational databases, large-scale caching instances, and heavy data warehousing pipelines.
